rest.front: turn-000.png is the original A-pose file, copied, not scaled.
rest.others: Drawn taller than the A-pose figure, then scaled down so the head sits at y=40 and the feet at y=1681.
rest.eyes: Open. Gaze goes with the head, not at the camera. Amber is her right eye. Green is her left eye. 90 and 270 are separate drawings, not mirrors.
rest.hair: High bun, short strands, no wind, no long hair.
rest.hands: A-pose rest. Slight spread, same soft curl, thumb in the same place.
rest.seam: 90 and 270 are one drawing each. The front three-quarter and back views add the calves under the knees, so a faint join can still show there.

eyes_rule: Her right eye is amber. Her left eye is green. The mark sits under one eye. A flipped angle would swap both, so every angle is its own still.
gaze: Fully open at rest. Look straight ahead with the head, not at the camera.
canonical_marks: turn-000: 1 mark under her right (amber) eye, 2 under her left (green) eye = viewer-right cheek in front views (plus a faint 1-2 px speck).

policy.rule: Only blend between stills that are both consistent. consistent = marks match turn-000, or marks are not visible (face turned away, expected).
policy.skip: default: blend directly between the nearest consistent stills on either side of the angle
policy.hold: alternative: hold the last consistent still (in the direction of travel) until the next consistent one is reached
policy.targets: inconsistent stills are never pose targets

talk.note: Talk clips are 768x1168 arms-down plates (not the A-pose, figure 1136 px tall vs 1641 on the rest canvas). Upscaling is not allowed by the rest spec (upscale:false), so they play 1:1 in the talk panel beside the stage, only while the head is at the front (|angle| <= 10°), keyed and with the Clean room white-flash skip.

hair.spec: High bun, short strands, no wind, no long hair.
hair.hide: Hair toggle uses the Clean room skin-fill mask (applyPartMask with hair off): hair pixels inside the skull ellipse take the mean face-skin colour sampled from the same still, the rest are made transparent. Authored-pixel masking, nothing drawn.
